title: Upper/Lower Hypertrophy
author: Average Man
desc:
This is designed as a hypertrophy program. 
Each exercise has 2 alternatives but feel free to pick anything you like doing. 

If a set calls for an extended set, use any of the following techniques,
Drop set
Cluster set
Rest Pause

Make sure you are using weight that challenges you and try to get as close to the required RPE as you can with 10 being nothing left inn the tank. 

For Progression you can either, 
increase the reps per set
add another set
increase the weight
If you increase the weight and the jump is too much, then go back to your previous weight and add another set or more reps and then try increase the weight later.
